## Interfaces/invariants
- Public constants PRO_PRICE_LABEL='US$15/month', HOODRICH_MINIMUM_FORMATTED='666,666'; minimum raw666666×10^18 exact integer. No floating eligibility, client balance overrides, proof/session loosening or pooled-wallet eligibility.
- Stripe new HOODLABS Pro recurring price: USD1500 cents/month/interval_count1/per_unit/licensed/active, correct prod_hoodlabs_pro. Use current configured exact price ID. No customer charges or bulk subscription migrations. Existing service configured checks remain fail-closed. Verify price terms before payable checkout and verify authoritative subscription item identity.
- Existing native/custom pair signing, transaction intents, journals, mounting, Pro revocation and browser key boundaries unchanged. Default protected preview and disabled live gate persist; hosted test does not imply real-money execution.
- Main www.hoodrich.rip is reference only. No owner .env.local or personal secrets enter public source/build/hosting. No credential values printed.
- Promo clearly represents preview when services unavailable; no return/safety guarantees. Exact image-model availability verified; disclose any tooling limitation, never claim an unselected model.

## Acceptance
233-test baseline reused from identical base; run relevant new boundary/price tests, combined full suite/typecheck/build, privacy scans, independent negative tests, compiled browser375/768/1440/keyboard/reduced-motion with actual screenshots. Fresh review binds final revision. GitHub CI, hosted exact revision/assets/domain/protection checks, Stripe authoritative USD15 monthlyprice verification. No synthetic proof labelled live.

| Risk | Likelihood | Mitigation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Price display/provider mismatch | Medium | Shared display constants, exact server price checks, Stripe read-back and hosted config check |
| Threshold off-by-one or stale access | Medium | Exact wei below/equal/above tests and existing fresh session-bound balance checks |
| Styling loses wallets or recovery | Medium | Preserve handlers and mount conditions; keyboard/mobile/session regressions |
| Unavailable account services | Present | Setup remains fail-closed, clearly report operational gap |
| Motion obscures forms | Medium | Restrained accents, pause/reduced-motion, no animated input surfaces |

Key principle: carry the Hoodrich identity into clear controls without weakening access or payment checks.
